Range Intelligent Computing.why: Invests in, builds, owns and operates campus-scale AI data centers (AIDC) in China and overseas, leasing wholesale IDC cabinets to internet and cloud majors and running its own AI compute clusters for AI-model customers, so AI compute build-out drives its capacity, revenue and capex.
Range Intelligent Computing.evidence: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026): within 2026 the company expects to deliver more than 300MW in China (Langfang park 200MW, Chongqing park 50MW, Huizhou park 40MW) and 60MW at Batam, Indonesia; its self-held high-performance server scale is industry-leading and AI compute revenue was nearly RMB 20 hundred million in H1 2026.

players.product: AIDC (AI data-center) campuses and AI compute services: nine AI infrastructure clusters (Langfang in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Pinghu, Foshan, Huizhou, Chongqing, Lanzhou, Danzhou; Sha Ling, Hong Kong; Batam, Indonesia), wholesale IDC cabinets for internet and cloud majors

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, results call of August 28, 2026): the 2026 delivery plan of more than 300MW in China includes Langfang park 200MW, Chongqing park 50MW and Huizhou park 40MW, plus 60MW at the Batam, Indonesia park (first batch, within 2026). Newly delivered 2026 capacity at Langfang, Chongqing, Huizhou and Batam all has firm orders or intentions. H2 2026 capex may rise substantially and 2027 domestic delivery is expected to grow considerably, depending on compute supply-chain availability; overseas cabinet delivery in 2027 is expected to grow clearly and may exceed the 2026 level, and the company will push quickly toward an overseas 1GW delivery target. Director, Board Secretary and CFO Dong Lei expects full-year 2026 operating cash flow above RMB 60 hundred million. If hardware purchases offer good cost-performance the company will rapidly raise compute capex, even temporarily raising its debt ratio, while using order profitability as a key decision basis.
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 delivery: Langfang 200MW, Chongqing 50MW, Huizhou 40MW, Batam 60MW; 2026 operating cash flow above RMB 60 hundred million expected

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the domestic compute market will stay supply-tight in the short term, with unit prices and profitability better than a year earlier; prices and gross margins of newly signed compute orders are rising. The two main industry constraints are irrational compute-equipment pricing this year (purchase prices keep deviating from a reasonable range) and supply shortages across the whole chain: not only high-performance servers but storage, optical modules, switches and related raw materials. CFO Dong Lei said that because of irrational competition in compute-equipment supply in H1 2026 the company strategically reduced purchases and focused on building its supply chain.

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record) on margins and returns: the H1 2026 AIDC gross-margin decline was mainly because the 2025 period included some delivery-type business; excluding it, compute gross margin was stable, and the company expects compute gross margin to stay around 45% over the long term and overall gross margin around 45%. AIDC compute equipment has a 5-6 year life and cabinet-business equipment more than 10 years; overseas cabinet business has the better return on investment, but domestic compute business brings larger absolute profit. CFO Dong Lei: adding back the assets moved into the REIT, H1 2026 net profit attributable would be RMB 13.2 hundred million, up 50%, with main-business profit still growing more than 30%; revenue-contributing parks now number 5.
quarterly_data.figure: Compute gross margin expected around 45% long term

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record) on cabinets and liquid cooling: IDC cabinet prices have begun to stabilise and rise; high-quality liquid-cooled cabinets deliverable in the short term are back to peak-period unit prices, and traditional cabinet prices are recovering gradually. More than 65% of the computing centers delivered in China in 2026 use liquid cooling (the rest air cooling), and overseas projects are basically all liquid-cooled. The 220MW delivered in 2025 is now mostly above 80% racked. Domestic projects can be delivered in as little as 3 months because infrastructure is built in advance; overseas projects take about 8 months after land levelling.
quarterly_data.figure: 65%+ of 2026 domestic deliveries liquid-cooled; 2025 deliveries above 80% racked

quarterly_data.quarter: Range Intelligent Computing IR activity record: 2026-002 (08-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record) on overseas markets: overseas the company runs only the cabinet business, while Hong Kong will also carry compute business. Dong Lei said Hong Kong computing-center supply deliverable in 2027 is already sold out and Southeast Asian cabinet prices have kept rising this year; management said Hong Kong local listed IDC operators have gross margins of nearly 57% and the company aims to reach that level, and that Southeast Asian average margins are better than China's.
